VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (what dinosaurs are) Ang mga dinosaur maoy karaang mga reptilya nga nabuhi sa Yuta mga 230 hangtod 66 ka milyon ka tuig kanhi. DILI sila mga mammal — mas duol sila sa modernong mga reptilya ug langgam. Lain-lain ang ilang gidak-on, gikan sa gamay hangtod sa dako kaayo.
- (fossils) Ang fossils mao ang salin o timaan sa karaang tanom ug hayop nga napreserbar sa bato. Motabang kini sa mga siyentista nga mahibaloan kung unsa ang nabuhi sa Earth milyon-milyon ka tuig na ang milabay.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita ra gud ang T-rex!

Ania ang T-rex — usa ka dakong theropod nga mokaon og karne!

[image: A Tyrannosaurus rex dinosaur with massive jaws, tiny arms, and a long tail.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (magnets attract iron and steel) Ang magnet magdani lamang sa pipila ka metal sama sa puthaw ug asero, dili sa tanan nga metal sama sa tumbaga o aluminyo.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Unsay hitsura sa triceratops? Patan-awa ko.

Ania ang triceratops — inila sa tulo ka sungay sa nawong niini!

[image: A triceratops dinosaur with three horns and a large neck frill.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (what is a fossil) Ang fossil mao ang nahibilin nga timaan o lawas sa tanom o hayop nga dugay nang nabuhi, nga natipigan sulod sa bato.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita kog fossil sa dinosaur!

Ania ang fossil sa dinosaur — timaan sa mananap nga nabuhi milyon-milyon ka tuig na ang milabay!

[image: A dinosaur fossil skeleton embedded in rock.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (whale shark butanding) Ang butanding (whale shark) mao ang pinakadako nga isda sa kalibotan, apan usa kini ka maaghop nga hayop nga adunay nindot nga puti nga puntik sa likod.
- (whale shark feeding) Bisan og dako kaayo, ang butanding mokaon lamang og gagmayng plankton pinaagi sa pagsala sa tubig-dagat sa dako niining baba.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patan-awa ko sa butanding!

Ania ang butanding — ang pinakadako nga isda sa tibuok kalibutan!

[image: A whale shark swimming with its wide flat mouth and spotted back.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (how a rainbow forms) Matawo ang balangaw kung ang kahayag sa adlaw moagi sa mga tulo sa ulan, nga magbahin sa kahayag ngadto sa pito ka kolor.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Naa kay picture sa whale shark?

Naa! Ania ang whale shark o butanding — isda gihapon kini bisan dako kaayo!

[image: A whale shark (butanding) with white spots swimming in the sea.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (jellyfish body) Ang dikya (jellyfish) walay utok, walay kasingkasing, ug walay bukog — halos puro tubig lang ang lawas niini. Bisan pa niini, minilyon na ka tuig nga nabuhi kini sa dagat.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto nakong makita ang salabay!

Ania ang salabay o jellyfish — talagsaong mananap nga walay utok!

[image: A jellyfish with a round bell and long trailing tentacles.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (the water cycle) Sa siklo sa tubig, ang tubig moalisngaw gikan sa dagat, mobugnaw aron mahimong panganod, ug mahulog balik isip ulan.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita ra gud ang seahorse.

Ania ang seahorse o kabayo sa dagat — tinuod kini nga isda!

[image: A seahorse with a curled tail floating upright in the water.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (starfish) Ang bituon sa dagat (starfish) kasagaran adunay lima ka bukton, ug makahimo kini og pagtubo balik sa nawala nga bukton. Wala kini utok o dugo nga sama sa ato.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pwede ba nakong makita ang starfish?

Ania ang starfish — makapatubo kini pag-usab sa naputol nga bukton niini!

[image: A starfish with five arms on the sea floor.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (sound travels through air) Ang tingog nagbiyahe agi sa hangin gikan sa gigikanan niini hangtod sa atong dalunggan.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Picture sa ngiwngiw palihog!

Ania ang ngiwngiw o kuwago — hanas nga mangangayam sa kagabhion!

[image: An owl (kuwago) with big round eyes perched on a branch.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (bat echolocation) Ang kabog mogamit og echolocation aron makakaplag og pagkaon sa kangitngit — mohimo kini og tingog ug maminaw sa alingugngog nga mobalik aron mahibaloan kon asa ang insekto o babag.
- (bat only flying mammal) Ang kabog mao ra ang mammal nga makalupad gyud pinaagi sa iyang mga pako.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita sa kabog bi!

Ania ang kabog — ang bugtong mammal nga tinuod nga makalupad!

[image: A bat flying at night with wings spread wide.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why a cold glass sweats) 'Magsingot' ang bugnaw nga baso tungod kay ang alisngaw sa tubig sa init nga hangin modikit sa bugnaw nga gawas, mawad-an og kusog, ug mahimong gagmayng tulo sa tubig. Kini ang condensation — kabaliktaran sa evaporation.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patan-awa kog buaya!

Ania ang buaya — usa sa pinakakusog mopaak nga mananap!

[image: A crocodile (buwaya) with a long snout and sharp teeth.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (penguins swim instead of fly) Ang mga penguin mga langgam nga dili makalupad, apan gamiton nila ang ilang mga pako sama sa bugsay aron molangoy ilalom sa tubig.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Naa kay hulagway sa penguin?

Naa! Ania ang penguin — langgam nga dili makalupad apan hanas molangoy!

[image: A penguin standing upright on ice.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (gravity pulls objects down) Ang grabidad usa ka pwersa nga nagbira sa mga butang paubos padulong sa yuta.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita palihog ang elepante!

Ania ang elepante — ang pinakadako nga mananap sa yuta!

[image: An elephant grabbing leaves with its long trunk.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (tallest animal giraffe) Ang giraffe mao ang pinakataas nga hayop sa kalibutan, makaabot og halos 5 ngadto sa 6 ka metro ang katas-on. Ang taas niini nga liog makatabang aron makakab-ot sa mga dahon sa taas nga mga kahoy.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto nakong makita ang giraffe!

Ania ang giraffe — ang pinakataas nga mananap sa kalibutan!

[image: A giraffe with a very long neck eating leaves from a tall tree.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (small static shocks are harmless) Ang gamay nga pagku-koryente nga imong mabati human magkis-kis sa karpet mao ang static electricity ug dili makadaot.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita ra gud ang suso!

Ania ang suso — dala-dala niini ang iyang balay nga shell!

[image: A snail (suso) with a spiral shell.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (spider webs) Ang lawalawa maghimo og lawa (web) gikan sa kaugalingong sutla (silk) nga lig-on kaayo aron makadakop sa mga insekto nga kaonon niini.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patan-awa sa balay sa lawa!

Ania ang balay sa lawa — hinabi gikan sa sutla nga gama sa lawas niini!

[image: A spider web with a spider at the center.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (wet clothes dry by evaporation in sun and wind) Momala ang basa nga sinina sa sampayan tungod kay mosingaw ang tubig niini ngadto sa hangin, ilabina kon init ang adlaw ug adunay hangin.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Naa kay pic sa buyog?

Naa! Ania ang buyog — kugihan nga tigdala sa pollen!

[image: A bee collecting nectar from a flower.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Jupiter's Great Red Spot) Ang Great Red Spot sa Jupiter usa ka higante nga bagyo nga mas dako pa sa tibuok Yuta nga nagtuyok na sulod sa gatusan ka tuig.
- (the planet Jupiter) Ang Jupiter mao ang pinakadako nga planeta — usa ka higante nga bola sa gas nga dako kaayo nga mahaom ang tanang ubang planeta sulod niini.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita ang planetang Jupiter!

Ania ang Jupiter — ang pinakadako nga planeta sa solar system!

[image: The planet Jupiter with its colorful bands and Great Red Spot.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (like poles repel unlike poles attract) Ang parehas nga polo sa duha ka magnet magsalikway sa usag usa, apan ang magkalahi nga polo magdani sa usag usa.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Unsay hitsura sa kometa? Ipakita!

Ania ang kometa — adunay taas kining ikog nga gas ug abog!

[image: A comet with a bright head and a long glowing tail in space.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (solar eclipse happens at new moon) Adunay solar eclipse kung moagi ang bulan tungatunga sa Earth ug Adlaw, mao nga moali kini sa kahayag ug mahulog ang anino sa bulan sa Earth. Mahitabo lang kini kung bag-ong bulan.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pwede ba makita ang solar eclipse?

Ania ang solar eclipse — gitabonan sa bulan ang adlaw!

[image: A solar eclipse with the moon blocking the sun, corona glowing.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (types of clouds) Adunay nagkalainlaing klase sa panganod: ang cumulus murag bulak, ang stratus nipis nga sapaw-sapaw, ug ang cirrus taas ug murag balhibo.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patan-awa ko sa lainlaing panganod!

Ania ang lainlaing matang sa panganod sa langit!

[image: A chart of different cloud types: cirrus, cumulus, and stratus.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Day and night from Earth's rotation) Aduna kitay adlaw ug gabii tungod kay ang Kalibotan magtuyok sa kaugalingong axis kausa matag 24 oras, busa ang bahin nga nag-atubang sa Adlaw adlaw ug ang likod gabii.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Gusto kong makita ang busay!

Ania ang busay — naghaguros nga tubig gikan sa itaas!

[image: A tall waterfall pouring down a rocky cliff.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Bangui wind farm Philippines) Ang Bangui Wind Farm sa Ilocos Norte adunay laray sa dagkong windmill sa daplin sa dagat nga maghimog koryente gikan sa hangin.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita ang mga windmill sa Bangui!

Ania ang mga windmill — gihimong kuryente ang kusog sa hangin!

[image: Tall wind turbines turning in the wind.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (why thunder comes after lightning) Atong makita una ang kilat sa dili pa madungog ang dalugdog tungod kay ang kahayag mas paspas molakaw kaysa tingog.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Naa kay picture sa telescope?

Naa! Ania ang telescope — gipaduol niini ang talan-awon sa kalangitan!

[image: A telescope on a tripod aimed at the stars.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (microscopes show living things are made of cells) Pinaagi sa mikroskopyo, nadiskobrehan sa mga siyentista nga ang mga tanom ug hayop gibuhat gikan sa gagmayng selula.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Ipakita palihog ang microscope!

Ania ang microscope — gipakita niini ang gagmay kaayo nga mga butang!

[image: A microscope for looking at very small things.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (objects fall at the same rate) Kon walay hangin nga makababag, ang bug-at ug gaan nga butang dungan nga mahulog kay gipaspas sila sa grabidad sa samang gidaghanon.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Pakita sa tabanog bi!

Ania ang tabanog — gipataas kini sa kusog sa hangin!

[image: A diamond-shaped kite (saranggola) flying in the wind.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (banana plant is a giant herb) Bisan og tawgon natong "punoan sa saging," dili kini tinuod nga kahoy — walay gahi nga kahoy ang punoan niini. Ang saging usa ka dako kaayo nga sagbot, ug ang "punoan" hinimo sa nag-uban-uban nga mga dahon.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patan-awa kog punoan sa saging!

Ania ang saging — sa tinuod, dako kining tanom nga sagbot ug dili tinuod nga kahoy!

[image: A banana plant (saging) with large leaves and bunches of bananas.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (Moon gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's) Ang grabidad sa Bulan mga ikaunom lang ka bahin sa grabidad sa Yuta.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Unsay hitsura sa humay? Ipakita ra gud!

Ania ang humay — matang kini sa sagbot nga gigikanan sa atong bugas!

[image: Rice plants (palay) growing in a flooded rice field.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (fungi are not plants) Ang uhong ug agup-op kay fungi, dili tanom. Dili sila berde ug dili sila maghimo sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon; mokuha sila og sustansya gikan sa patay o nadunot nga butang.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Naa kay hulagway sa uhong?

Naa! Ania ang uhong — dili kini tanom kondili fungus!

[image: A mushroom (kabute) with a cap and stem.]

VERIFIED FACTS FROM THE CURRICULUM (use these as your source of truth):
- (volcanic ash cloud and ashfall) Kon mobuto ang bulkan, mahimo kining mobuga ug baga nga panganod sa abo nga mahulog isip ashfall; importante nga magsul-ob ug mask aron dili kini masuyop.

When the question is answered by the facts above, base your explanation on them and do not contradict them. Still teach in your own words at the student's level — do not just copy the fact. If the facts above do not cover the question, answer carefully from general knowledge and say so if you are unsure.

Patan-awa sa nagbuto nga bulkan!

Ania ang nagbuto nga bulkan — moulbo ang abo ug aso gikan niini!

[image: An erupting volcano with smoke and ash rising from its crater.]
